hero.body: Zeno runs the school behind your lessons: streaming that resists piracy, payments in your students' own currency, and a ledger that accounts for every sale.

how.title: One upload. Four quiet steps.
how.body: Everything between your camera and a student's screen happens on its own, in this order, every time.

upload.label: Upload
upload.title: Straight from the browser
upload.body: In parts, so a dropped connection only costs the part in flight. Close the laptop; it picks up where it stopped.

transcode.label: Transcode
transcode.title: Five qualities from one file
transcode.body: 240p to 1080p, so a slow connection gets a smooth picture instead of a spinner.

protect.label: Protect
protect.title: Locked a few seconds at a time
protect.body: Every segment encrypted on its own. Keys go only to a student who paid, on at most three devices.

deliver.label: Deliver
deliver.title: From the edge nearest them
deliver.body: Students stream from close by, wherever they are, and pick up where they left off.

who.title: Built for how you teach.
who.body: Whether you sell recorded courses, run live cohorts or are the one learning, Zeno does the same work underneath.

cards.body: A payment is applied once, however many times the provider sends it, even when the database falls over halfway.
Fees, refunds and payouts live in a double-entry ledger that refuses to be out of balance.
A paid student watches on up to three devices. The keys go to them and no one else.
A browser on any phone. Quality follows the connection; playback picks up where it stopped.
